visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An adult male in a white t-shirt stands in a modern domestic kitchen. He holds a glass dish containing three scoops of bright green ice cream topped with a large bunch of fresh cilantro. He takes a bite, appearing shocked, while a young girl in a red plaid dress stands beside him. (2) The man is shown eating green-colored tortilla chips from a white bowl, looking contemplative. (3) He stands behind a kitchen counter presenting a silver and black 'NINJA' branded ice cream maker. Various ingredients are displayed: a bundle of cilantro, jars of cream and milk, and bowls of sugar. (4) A bright green liquid is poured from a pink shaker into a clear plastic pint container. The container is then placed into a freezer drawer with a label indicating '24 hours'. (5) The man takes the frozen tub out and locks it into the Ninja Creami machine. Close-ups show his finger pressing the digital control panel, selecting the 'Ice Cream' function. The machine spins, visibly processing the mixture. (6) The lid is removed, revealing a crumbly green texture which becomes smooth after another spin. The man uses a silver scoop to create perfect green spheres. (7) He feeds the cilantro ice cream to a young boy and the girl; both children react with surprise and smiles. (8) A second demonstration begins using a beige base and chopped dark 'century eggs' (pidan). The machine is shown in 'Mix-in' mode, incorporating the solid pieces. (9) The final pidan ice cream is scooped into a bowl and garnished with more egg chunks, bonito flakes, and a dark soy-style sauce. The man takes a large bite, looking overwhelmed but impressed. (10) The man speaks directly to the camera, gesturing towards the machine, with several graphic text overlays appearing around him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal male vocal exclamation 'Ha?' followed immediately by an upbeat, driving electronic pop track with a clear 4/4 drum beat. A sharp metallic clink of a spoon hitting glass is heard. (2) The male speaker launches into a rapid-fire narration. His tone is enthusiastic and energetic. Subtle 'pop' and 'bubble' sound effects punctuate the variety text appearing on screen. (3) A distinct mechanical whirring sound (rising in frequency) triggers a new phase as the ice cream machine starts. The BGM remains constant, providing a high-energy backdrop. (4) A 'ding' bell sound effect signals the end of the first cycle. The male voice shouts excitedly '鬆化完成!', followed by high-pitched, joyful laughter and vocalizations from the children. (5) A synthesized 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the start of the second recipe. The narration continues with high pitch variability as ingredients are introduced. (6) Another mechanical whirring cycle is heard, layered with the percussive BGM. A cartoonish 'boing' SFX emphasizes a visual gag. (7) The male speaker's voice becomes even more dramatic as he tries the final product, characterized by a sharp rise in volume and pitch. The audio concludes with a final clear branding statement and a 'tada' style musical flourish.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration 1 -> Demonstration 2 -> Comparison -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional demonstration of the Ninja Creami ice cream maker. By using extremely unconventional and controversial ingredients like cilantro and century eggs, the creator grabs attention (the 'hook') and proves the machine's ability to create a smooth, 'professional' texture from almost any base. The inclusion of children's positive reactions acts as social proof to validate the product's performance and fun factor, ultimately leading to a call-to-action to visit the official website.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focuses entirely on the brand 'NINJA' and its 'CREAMi' product, shows the unboxing/setup, demonstrates specific features (Creamify technology), and ends with a verbal and textual call to visit the official website.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly effective social-media-style product ad utilizing fast-paced editing, bright visuals, and shock-value recipes to maintain high viewer retention.
